description:
USE THIS TOOL WHEN you have a known Act / SI and want the structural table of contents (parts, chapters, individual sections/regulations/articles).

Returns XML ids and titles in document order, including Parts,
chapters, crossheadings, and provisions; a rare untitled provision is
retained as its bare id. Results are paginated with offset/limit.

AFTER calling, pass a provision's bare number (for example `47`, not
`section-47`) to legislation_get_section. Check has_more and
total_items for large statutes. Use read_resource with the
legislation:// toc URI for the full raw listing.

Source: legislation.gov.uk CLML table of contents.

limit.description: Maximum items to return in this call (default 200, max 1000). Raise only when you need a larger slice in one response. Check has_more and total_items to know if further pages exist.

offset.description: Number of items to skip from the flattened TOC. Use with limit to page through very large statutes like the Companies Act 2006 (1300+ items).

type.description: Legislation type code: 'ukpga' (Acts), 'uksi' (SIs), 'asp' (Scottish Acts), 'nia' (NI Acts). Use the value from legislation_search results.

name: legislation_get_toc

outputSchema.description:
Paginated table of contents for an Act or Statutory Instrument.

The upstream XML is fetched in one shot (legislation.gov.uk has no
server-side pagination), then sliced client-side via offset/limit.
For very large statutes like the Companies Act 2006 (1300+ items)
use offset to page through. Check has_more and total_items to
know the full size.

has_more.description: True if more items remain beyond offset+returned

items.description: TOC entries in XML document order, formatted as '<id>: <title>', e.g. 'section-47: Definitions'. When calling legislation_get_section pass only the numeric part ('47', not 'section-47').

number.description: Chapter or SI number echoed from the request

offset.description: Offset applied to the full TOC item list

returned.description: Number of items in this response

total_items.description: Total structural items parsed from the XML, before offset/limit. Compare to `returned` and `has_more` to decide whether to paginate.

type.description: Legislation type code echoed from the request

year.description: Year of enactment echoed from the request

title: Get Legislation Table of Contents
